q: Where is The Muscular Junction physiotherapy clinic located?
a: The Muscular Junction is located in Zone V, River Gardens, Islamabad. We regularly treat patients travelling from across Islamabad and Rawalpindi, including Bahria Town, DHA Islamabad, Gulberg Greens, Soan Gardens and PWD.

q: Do I need a doctor's referral to book a physiotherapy session?
a: No referral is needed. You can book directly with The Muscular Junction on WhatsApp, by phone, or through the online booking form. If you already have an MRI, X-ray or a surgeon's protocol, bring it — it helps us plan your rehabilitation faster.

q: What happens in the first physiotherapy appointment?
a: Your first visit is a full assessment lasting around 45 to 60 minutes. We take your history, test your movement and strength, explain what we believe is causing the problem, and agree a treatment plan with you — including roughly how many sessions it should take. Most patients also start hands-on treatment in that same visit.

q: How many sessions will I need?
a: It depends on the condition. Most musculoskeletal problems such as back pain or a frozen shoulder improve over 4 to 8 sessions, while post-operative and sports rehabilitation typically runs 8 to 16 weeks. You will be given an honest estimate at your first assessment, and we review progress as we go rather than booking open-ended courses.

q: What conditions do you treat at your physiotherapy clinic?
a: We treat back and neck pain, sciatica, sports injuries, frozen shoulder, arthritis, sprains and strains, post-surgery and post-fracture rehabilitation, stroke and other neurological conditions, and pediatric developmental delays — using manual therapy, sports rehab, orthopedic, neurological and pediatric physiotherapy, dry needling and cupping.

q: What are your clinic timings and how do I book?
a: The clinic is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM and Saturday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and is closed on Sunday. The fastest way to book is WhatsApp — send us a message and our team will confirm a slot, usually the same day.

q: Do you offer physiotherapy workshops and training for clinicians?
a: Yes. We run hands-on, certified physiotherapy workshops in Islamabad — Dry Needling, Kinesio Taping, Mulligan Techniques, HVLA Chiropractic, Cupping Therapy and Therapeutic Exercise — led by Dr. Syed Mozaffar. We also arrange in-house training for clinics and universities.
